We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to get NMR data perhaps to infer aromatic carbons. Use carbon NMR spectra tool to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon signals (typically 110-160 ppm). Could also use HSQC but maybe carbon NMR enough.

We need to call carbon_nmr_spectra (no args).
